EXACT-MODEL FIT

What is shared, and what needs checking?

Exact robot model
Roborock's English Qrevo S5V manual identifies robot model RRW0PEP. Check the app or underside label if your unit says Qrevo S, Pro, MaxV, Curv or Edge instead.
DuoDivide main brush
The S5V uses two short, parallel rollers with spiral blades. Roborock sells this brush for the S5V; a single full-width Qrevo S roller is a different design.
Robot filter vs. dock bag
The washable filter fits the robot dustbin. The disposable 2.7 L E12-rated bag fits the multifunctional dock. They are separate parts and cannot be substituted for one another.
Shared accessories
Roborock lists some individual filters and brush parts for several models, including the S5V, Curv and Edge. That shared listing does not confirm that every part in a multi-model kit fits all of them.
CLEAN FIRST, REPLACE WHEN NEEDED

Roborock Qrevo S5V maintenance intervals

The manufacturer’s published care guidance for this model gives these intervals. Wear and your cleaning routine can change when a part needs replacement; follow the replacement manufacturer’s care instructions too.

Roborock Qrevo S5V cleaning and replacement intervals
PartCleanReplace
DuoDivide main brushEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Side brushMonthlyEvery 3–6 months
Washable robot filterEvery 2 weeksEvery 6–12 months
Mop clothsAs neededEvery 1–3 months
Dock dust bagDisposableAs needed

Switch off the robot before maintenance. Rinse the washable filter with clean water only and leave it to air-dry for at least 24 hours before reinstalling. Keep a disposable dust bag installed whenever the dock auto-empties.

Before you order

Will a Qrevo S replacement brush fit the Qrevo S5V?

Do not assume so. The S5V uses Roborock's DuoDivide split-roller brush. The original Qrevo S uses a different full-width roller. Use a listing that names Qrevo S5V and shows the DuoDivide brush.

How often should I replace Qrevo S5V filters and brushes?

Roborock recommends replacing the washable robot filter and main brushes every 6–12 months, and the side brush every 3–6 months. Clean the filter and main brush every 2 weeks and the side brush monthly.

Which dust bag does the Qrevo S5V dock use?

Roborock describes a 2.7 L E12-rated disposable dock bag and says its capacity can cover up to 7 weeks of use. The linked third-party pack is labeled 2.7 L and names Qrevo S5V; check both details on the selected listing.

Are these all genuine Roborock parts?

The linked DuoDivide main brush and side brushes are Roborock-branded originals. The filters, bags and mop cloths are third-party products; their compatibility comes from their Amazon sellers and has not been fit-tested by DustMigo.
